text: The Ula'tek Snakehead Lure is a fishing lure created with Midnight Fishing to increase the chance to catch Ula'tek Snakehead. It is taught by Recipe: Ula'tek Snakehead Lure, which can be purchased from Jan'sari the Watchful in the Coiled Isle. To craft this lure, go into the Fishing Journal and find it under the "Crafting" section of Midnight Fishing.
Ula'tek Snakehead is a fish that can be caught in the waters of the Coiled Isle. Using an Ula'tek Snakehead Lure greatly increases the odds of fishing them up.

Unbound Battle is a player vs. player achievement earned by completing all eight PvP world quests in Khaz Algar at least once. These world quests are only accessible with War Mode turned on.

Unbound Phaseblades are void ethereals located in the Unbound Vault in Manaforge Omega. They look like souls in their containers but if they are allowed to finish their cast, they become Shadowguard Phaseblades.
Unbound Entities are void ethereals located in the Unbound Vault in Manaforge Omega.

Umbral Tin veins are found in Eversong Woods, Zul'Aman, and Harandar.

Unalloyed Abundance is the currency for , obtained at the Abundance event. The currency is used to purchase items sold by Chel the Chip.
The Unbreathing Soul is a banshee that spawns at the Ruins of Nar'thalas in Azsuna during The Walk of Shame.
Un'Goro Green Dye was a housing dye used to color certain housing decor. It could be crafted by alchemists or scribes via Dye Crafting with 1 Teal Dye Pigment.
Umbral Tentacles are void tentacles that spawn during the Viceroy Nezhar encounter in the Seat of the Triumvirate dungeon.

Umbral Ashes are an achievement reward from Umbral Champion: Midnight Season 1.

Undermine Undershirt is acquired via a short puzzle in the Undermine. Enter the sewer grate at just southwest of the entrance to Sidestreet Sluice in the Vatworks. Downstairs, look for a barrel with a slice of Sewer Cheese on it. Take the cheese back to the Hungry Rat at the entrance to the sewer. The rat hands over a Tarnished Undermine Real (retail). Check in with Pix Xizzix at upstairs in the Port Authority of Blackwater Marina to trade the real for the shirt. It has the same appearance as the Songbird Blouse, a leather chest item that drops from Hearthsinger Forresten in Stratholme.

A unit token (or unitId) identifies a unit by their relationship to the player as a target, party member, pet, or other such role. Several API functions accept UnitToken as an argument for whom the action applies, though some functions only accept a subset of possible values. Unit tokens are case insensitive.
Unhatched Battery is located in the Char in the Emerald Dream. It can be studied immediately, but will otherwise turn into a Depleted Battery (Engineering) after the duration runs out.
Unjiup is a tuskarr located at the Drifter's Dive in the Azure Span. He guards The Drifter and is in turn guarded by Ujni.
Unleashed Nature Spirit is a treant located in Starbreeze Village in and near the Bael'dun Digsite in western . It appears when the Glade Crown or Prairie Crown are used at a Wooden Effigy.
Unidentifiable Equine Fossil drops from Doomshadow in the Azure Span.
Unfaceted Purple Gemstone drops from Glintwick in the Ringing Deeps.
The Unhatched Green Dragon Egg is found at the Yorgen Farmstead in during Nightmare Incursions.
Unfinished Rush'kah are enchanted tikis made from rush'kah located in the Darkspear Training Grounds on the Echo Isles during the Heritage of the Darkspear.
Uniting Severed Threads concludes the Azj-Kahet storyline, and thus, the level-up portion of The War Within campaign. The max-level The War Within (achievement) storyline starts at level .
Unfinished Note is found at in Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet, surrounded by some Rotglow Settlers while on Ratts' Race. It reads:
Unleashed Souls were wraiths. Given their ID range is close to Crazed Apothecary, they may have been planned for the Love is in the Air version of Shadowfang Keep.

The Unlabeled Document is found in the room past the Chamber Door in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. The document is in the language of either Eredun (demonic), nerubian, or nerglish, selected by the game at random. Using Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian allows the nerubian version to be read.
The Unfortunate Goblin is a dead goblin located in the cave under Campalot in the Ringing Deeps. They were killed by the Lady of the Lake.

Unk'omon is a boss found in the jail area of the Karazhan Crypts. He can be summoned by speaking to Alfwhit Grigdert inside the secret room after defeating the Dark Rider. Doing so will send him to the jail area; speak to him again and he will summon Unk'omon.
Unfinished Stone Golems are golems located in the Forbidden Reach.
Unleashed Earths is a earth elemental located in the Forbidden Reach.
